messages:
maya: Taking over weekend oncall from 2026-07-03 17:00 -> 2026-07-05 09:00. Quick FYI: we still have two postmortem actions that might affect weekend traffic:
1) analytics.events DB index not fully verified on prod (staging OK)
2) worker retry backoff fix merged but not promoted to prod
Can someone confirm status? Also need coverage swap 23:00-03:00 — @sam can you cover that slot?

sam: I can take 23:00-03:00 except Sunday night I need to step out 00:30-01:30. Will set a calendar block. :thumbsup:

asha: analytics index rolled out to prod at 16:12. Ran: `SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename='analytics_events';` shows idx_ae_event_time present. Deployed by infra-db-migration job.

liam: retry backoff fix is merged (PR #1421) but staging rollout flaked on 03/26. I made hotfix branch `retry-fix-hot` and will run a canary tonight 21:00. If green, promote to prod before @maya starts.

ciara: quick note — console alert for queue-length spikes was noisy, I lowered threshold earlier. Config is ops/alerts/queues.yaml if you need to re-enable. /cc @maya :eyes:

maya: thanks. @liam please ping when canary is green. @sam set yourself as primary for 23:00-03:00 and add escalation to me. I'll drop a short runbook in #eng-oncall pinned.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Oncall rotation starts for maya at 1772103345.

sam: added calendar event and set PagerDuty -> primary. If liam wants a hand with canary, I'm free 20:30-22:00.

liam: canary completed 21:07 — traffic test passed. Rolling to prod now: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/worker`. Monitoring logs: `kubectl logs -f deploy/worker -c worker --since=5m | grep RetryPolicy`.

asha: confirmed prod shows new retry metrics: `retry_attempts_total` decreased ~18% in the last 5m. :tada:

maya: great. Closing loop: analytics index OK, retry fix deployed 21:25. Weekend coverage: Sam primary 23:00-03:00, Maya backup. Leaving handover note in the doc. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
